sources.source_kind: firsthand issue report and followup, not independently reproduced
findings: Initial macOS serviceshell timeout was followed by a reported success on the same model using Conda Python3.11, Homebrew libusb and an inline sudo environment path.

The success instructions do not describe a changed authentication algorithm or source patch. The claimed cause of the improvement is the reporter's explanation, not a USB trace or controlled isolation experiment.
The goal was PAL/NTSC setting modification; this is not modified firmware flashing, complete firmware restoration or an independent brick recovery report.
The initial tutorial reports FX3/FX30 language changes through an Ubuntu ARM VM on Apple Silicon; its title/body do not supply classic FX3 firmware7.02 acceptance evidence.
Later reports name other models; the August2026 FX5 comment is a question, not a success or recovery test.

sources.finding: A request to reverse engineer FX3 firmware7.02 for battery behavior; the viewed discussion had no implementation comments. It supplies no working unlock or recovery artifact.

API_comment_fetch_failures.fallback: Read the public715 and504 issue pages with the web tool; no credentials, private account or camera access used.
